status_rule: NotVerified means automated or synthetic evidence exists but the required real workflow has not been observed.

entries.title: Gmail 登录
entries.evidence_scope: Synthetic loopback OAuth, state/PKCE, failure classification and protected credential fixtures.
entries.required_real_evidence: A real Google Desktop OAuth login, restart refresh and reconnect on a clean Windows user.
entries.blocking_condition: No real Google account and current native Windows acceptance session.

entries.title: OpenAI／DeepSeek／Claude／GLM 登录
entries.evidence_scope: Real SDK code paths with synthetic credentials, provider catalog and auth cancellation/retry tests.
entries.required_real_evidence: One user-selected provider login, model verification, restart and credential refresh.
entries.blocking_condition: No real provider account or model request authorized.

entries.title: 导师方向分析
entries.evidence_scope: Synthetic source evidence, paper scope, profile-version boundaries and structured semantic output validation.
entries.required_real_evidence: A real model run using a selected public faculty source and a human check of citations and claims.
entries.blocking_condition: No real model account or selected source scope.

entries.title: 邮件撰写
entries.evidence_scope: Draft versioning, frozen references, CAS and preservation of human edits under synthetic model responses.
entries.required_real_evidence: A real or user-selected model draft reviewed in the WPF editor with references and attachments.
entries.blocking_condition: No real model workflow or current native editor session.

entries.title: 用户确认发送
entries.evidence_scope: One-time confirmation, immutable MIME, duplicate-click prevention, Unknown recovery and protected send state.
entries.required_real_evidence: A user explicitly confirms one concrete message in the UI, then verifies the sent record and outcome.
entries.blocking_condition: No user-authorized real mail send; real sending is intentionally excluded from automated runs.

entries.title: 学校／学院窗口表
entries.evidence_scope: Synthetic current/historical window rules, cycle separation, import idempotency and school aggregation fixtures.
entries.required_real_evidence: A selected school's public notices checked against current actual windows and historical projections.
entries.blocking_condition: Source range and first school seed list are still undecided.

entries.title: 学院画像、背景 bar、导师评价
entries.evidence_scope: Denominator-aware synthetic statistics, provenance, unknown values and faculty evidence fixtures.
entries.required_real_evidence: A real faculty sample with source-backed identity, background and evaluation claims checked by a human.
entries.blocking_condition: No selected school/faculty source scope and no real source review.

entries.title: 学院推荐
entries.evidence_scope: Synthetic eligibility, stable scoring, semantic unknowns and recommendation snapshot fixtures.
entries.required_real_evidence: A recommendation run from selected profile/needs versions with source citations and a human review of eligibility.
entries.blocking_condition: No real candidate source pool or model run.

entries.title: 学院全部导师采集
entries.evidence_scope: Synthetic directory pagination, identity resolution, coverage failures and collector manifest validation.
entries.required_real_evidence: One selected school's complete public directory crawl, coverage report and manual spot check.
entries.blocking_condition: No fixed school seed list or real source crawl authorized.

entries.title: 根据 CV／需求排名导师
entries.evidence_scope: Synthetic confirmed-profile versions, preference strengths, eligibility states and stable ranking.
entries.required_real_evidence: A user-confirmed CV/needs version ranked against a real faculty pool with explainable citations.
entries.blocking_condition: No real CV review plus selected source pool and model run.

entries.title: 分析／投递数据库及美观表格
entries.evidence_scope: Typed custom tables, relations, views, edits, import/export/recovery, virtualization configuration and portable package contracts.
entries.required_real_evidence: Current Windows package rendered and operated by a user across editing, import, export, backup restore and send-state protection.
entries.blocking_condition: Current Linux host cannot run WPF; clean Windows user acceptance is still required.
